notes.title: [Ad Break] Introducing Outcast Tales: The First Journey
notes.content:
Greetings, dear viewers!

While the COMUNITV crew is still hard at work on recovering footage from Drowned Lake, today we got a word from our friends at Hardlane Studio who just released the free prologue chapter to their upcoming game Outcast Tales, titled Outcast Tales: The First Journey.

[previewyoutube=T2JRPrdKnPA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/882590/Outcast_Tales_The_First_Journey/

Outcast Tales is a turn-based tactical rogue-like gang of (un)likeable misfits trying to brave deadly Wastelands… and each other’s opinions. Mix and match the classes AND personalities of your crewmates, explore (and plunder) the Wastelands, fight formidable enemies and write your own Tale!


 Outcast Tales: The First Journey is a completely free to play first chapter of Outcast Tales
 Audio narration for the events, done by Samuel Barnett — the famous Dirk Gently  from Dirk Gently’s Holistic Detective Agency and Delamain from Cyberpunk 2077!
 Contracts: a series of side-quests that you can complete across multiple playthroughs and unlock new gear, abilities and even new classes and personalities
 Twitch Integration — interact with your friends or viewers through a multitude of features!


If you want to learn more about Outcast Tales or wish to chat with other wastelanders, consider following Outcast Tales on X (formerly known as Twitter), joining CRITICAL REFLEX Discord and wishlisting the full game on Steam to be the first to play it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551970/Outcast_Tales/


This message was brought to you by the CR Channel. Join our terrifyingly good Discord community, where we're all about horrors!

notes.title: TELEFORUM is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear viewers.

We have a special report for you today: TELEFORUM is now officially Steam Deck Verified. 

This opens up infinite possibilities for watching the forbidden tape, so we at COMUNITV decided to give you a few ideas:


 Watch TELEFORUM on a plane. It’s a perfectly suitable feature-length experience for shorter flights, after all.
 Watch TELEFORUM in your bed. Recommended for those who want to keep dreaming about TELEFORUM during sleep.
 Watch TELEFORUM during an interview of a grieving widow. Wait, don’t you also need to hold the camera?
 Watch TELEFORUM on a fishing boat. Make sure to wear headphones and don’t make a sound.
 Watch TELEFORUM.
 Don’t stop watching TELEFORUM.
 Show TELEFORUM to your loved ones.
 BECOME ONE WITH TELEFORUM.
 THE PROGRAMME IS NEVER OVER.
 [spoiler]NOVOMUNDO[/spoiler]

notes.title: Free update TELEFORUM: DELETED SCENES available now!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/kfwK7am.gif

Dear viewers,

To celebrate the announcement of our next game — DROWNED LAKE — we are releasing a free content update for TELEFORUM — a director’s cut of sorts. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186570/TELEFORUM/

We hope you’ll enjoy TELEFORUM: DELETED SCENES and uncover the secrets the ◊◊◊◊◊◊◊◊◊ didn’t want you to see. 

Warning: multiple people have reported cases of false memory after watching DELETED SCENES. Almost as if… the tape itself was recording and re-recording some of its older versions. Viewer discretion is advised.

————————————

COMING UP NEXT ON COMUNITV: DROWNED LAKE

[previewyoutube=w9SHWqIj45A;full][/previewyoutube]

Unravel the truth of the Drowned Lake in a non-linear horror story inspired by the legends and nightmares of Brazilian folklore. Explore your haunting surroundings by boat, collect lost evidence with a fishing rod, solve puzzles in first-person POV, and try to avoid disturbing these troubled waters. Don’t let the Drowned Lake fool you. Remember: you're not safe here!

Add the next Monumental Collab game to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601540/DROWNED_LAKE

P.S. A lot of people in the community were asking us for an option to support TELEFORUM, so we’re also launching the TELEFORUM: SUPPORTER PACK for our dear viewers at home. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690730/TELEFORUM__Supporter_Pack/

Inside you will find:

 A digital artbook. Take a peek behind the curtain of TELEFORUM development and our approach to the horror genre as a whole. Partly Monumental Collab’s manifest, partly a deconstruction of TELEFORUM — that’s our gift to the most dedicated of our viewers.
 TELEFORUM Original Soundtrack. Ambient tunes to interview grieving widows to. Composed by Nickolas “Kaedalus” Jaques, available in MP3 and WAV.
 TELEFORUM Wallpapers. Take TELEFORUM everywhere with you. Become one with TELEFORUM. The programme is never over.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 - nominate TELEFORUM for Outstanding Story-Rich Game
notes.content:
Hello, dear viewers!

We once again thank you for all the amazing support you’ve showed for TELEFORUM! If you have already experienced and enjoyed the mystery of Walter Martin, consider nominating TELEFORUM for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game category during Steam Awards 2023. If you’ve already nominated another game, you can always show your appreciation of our work by leaving a review.

And in case you’ve yet to uncover the truth behind Walter Martin’s TELEFORUM — now is the best time to play it! The game is absolutely free to play and we believe that its story is well worth your time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/b33d66553f45c94dda2d6f03289e3a1934df60f8.png

STAY TUNED FOR FURTHER BROADCASTS.
